name: Add-on Popularity
query:
SELECT
    addon.item AS "Add-On Type:Link/Airplane Ticket Add-on Type:250",
    COUNT(addon.name) AS "Sold Count:Int:150"
FROM
    `tabAirplane Ticket Add-on Item` AS addon
INNER JOIN
    `tabAirplane Ticket` AS ticket
    ON ticket.name = addon.parent
WHERE
    ticket.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY
    addon.item
ORDER BY
    COUNT(addon.name) DESC
